common_name: Pandanus-Specialist West African Fly (Female Dark/Light Dimorphic Morphs)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila erecta (2.3 µm, detail scale)

specimen.license_note: Vendored project gallery fallback. Live Wikimedia Commons bitmap search and GBIF media for usageKey 5074045 returned no CC photograph of Drosophila erecta on 2026-10-27.

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg (1979): f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.dispersion: h(k^2) = Du Dv k^4 - (Dv fu + Du gv) k^2 + (fu gv - fv gu)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv fu + Du gv) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.disk_mode: I(r) = A J0(k r) exp(-r^2 / 2 s^2) + B exp(-r^2 / 2 s2^2) + C

chronoseries_comparison.note: All three chronospecies are Holocene (0 Ma). What changes at this slot is the selected tier of the dispersion relation, not geological age. Predecessor and successor characteristic lengths are the primordium-tier sizes already recorded for those species; they are comparison anchors, not parameters of this fit. This slot does not reuse elegans alpha=1.33/beta=0.252, erecta primordium alpha=1.63/beta=0.22, or eugracilis alpha=1.555/beta=0.316.

predecessor.biological_contrast: Morning-glory flower-breeding fly with an apical melanic wing patch. No erecta-like balanced tan dimorphism is encoded at the 2.262 µm tier.

focal.biological_contrast: Female dark/light colour dimorphism maintained by ancient balancing selection at the tan male-specific enhancer (Yassin et al. 2016). The enhancer alleles are modelled as two activator production rates a at fixed diffusivity, so wavelength stays near k_c while pigment amplitude changes.

successor.biological_contrast: Southeast Asian gracile fruit fly with reduced tarsal sex-comb teeth. The in-repo primordium wavelength remains ~100.6 µm; it is not a 2.262 µm intra-epidermal granule spacing.

reported_in_source: Turing (1952) dispersion relation for two reacting and diffusing morphogens
Yassin et al. (2016) mapped erecta female colour dimorphism to tan and reported ancient balancing selection at the male-specific enhancer
The vendored gallery image carries a drawn 100 µm scale bar
reconstructed_in_script: Diffusivities chosen so the Schnakenberg critical wavelength equals the assigned 2.262 µm detail tier
Axisymmetric J0 disk mode fitted to the gallery annulus
Dark versus light morphs as two values of production rate a at fixed Du, Dv
transfer_boundary: 2.262 µm is the assigned subcellular detail tier for this slot, not a length Yassin et al. measured on a micrograph
The gallery field's dark annulus is a ~100 µm primordium-scale ring; it is not itself the 2.262 µm wavelength
does_not_claim: Does not claim Drosophila elegans is a literal ancestor or that geological age changes along this chronoseries
Does not claim the tan enhancer sets the numerical value of Dv/Du
Does not claim a wild-caught CC photograph was available
